sql: SELECT toString(toStartOfHour(toTimeZone(created_at, 'America/New_York'))) AS b, count() AS v FROM orders WHERE toDate(toTimeZone(created_at, 'America/New_York')) >= toDate(now('America/New_York')) - 700 AND toDate(toTimeZone(created_at, 'America/New_York')) < toDate(now('America/New_York')) GROUP BY b

SELECT toString(toStartOfHour(toTimeZone(created_at, 'America/New_York'))) AS b, sumOrNull(amount) AS v FROM orders WHERE toDate(toTimeZone(created_at, 'America/New_York')) >= toDate(now('America/New_York')) - 700 AND toDate(toTimeZone(created_at, 'America/New_York')) < toDate(now('America/New_York')) GROUP BY b
SELECT toString(toStartOfHour(toTimeZone(created_at, 'Pacific/Apia'))) AS b, 1.0 * sum(amount) / nullIf(count(), 0) AS v FROM orders WHERE status != 'processing' GROUP BY b
SELECT toString(toStartOfHour(toTimeZone(created_at, 'Pacific/Apia'))) AS b, sumOrNull(quantity) AS v FROM orders WHERE status != 'processing' GROUP BY b
SELECT toString(toStartOfHour(toTimeZone(created_at, 'Asia/Kathmandu'))) AS b, maxOrNull(amount) AS v FROM orders WHERE status != 'processing' GROUP BY b

SELECT toString(toStartOfHour(created_at)) AS b, 1.0 * sumOrNullIf(amount, status IN ('completed','shipped')) / nullIf(sum(amount), 0) AS v FROM orders WHERE toDate(created_at) >= toDate(now('UTC')) - 700 AND toDate(created_at) < toDate(now('UTC')) GROUP BY b
SELECT toString(toStartOfHour(created_at)) AS b, minOrNull(toString(status)) AS v FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY b
SELECT toString(toStartOfHour(created_at)) AS b, sumOrNull(amount * quantity) AS v FROM orders WHERE status != 'cancelled' GROUP BY b
